text: This force can raid enemy territory for extra income !
Focus on plundering the local region, increasing the amount of loot gained per turn and providing extra income depending on the buildings of the region
• Depredation provides Raiding income while in the Depredation(raiding) stance.
• Depredation raiding income is based on buildings in the targeted region.
• Depredation raiding income is reduced by Military buildings.
• Depredation raiding income is increased by Commerce and Industry buildings.
